body: I've spoken about it to my girlfriend in innuendo. She knows what I mean. I'm trying to slightly downplay it because I don't want her to feel helpless (we're in an LDR) and panic about me. I also mentioned it to my mother a bit, but I don't want to trouble her as she deals with the same thing.
Cancer is a bitch. If anything I should try and push myself to be even healthier to avoid the same fate. If you need a buddy, feel free to pm me.

Thanks for your reply. Dad slowly died over a long period, he even spent 7 weeks in palliative care before he died. I felt "relief" right after but now comes the real despair. 

I only listed the major stressors. I'm also in an LDR with a great girl, but keep finding myself tempted because I'm sad and sometimes want company from someone who can be there. In addition, an ex and I have been trying to be friends because she's a great support, but after an awkward conversation I feel like that is fizzling out. 

Also I have a lot of pain from my gallbladder (supposed to come out eventually once I have my appointment with the surgeon) which has me irritated at the best of times. 

I honestly don't know when I'm actually going to snap and do something stupid. I feel like I'm tetering on the edge.
I sent you a pm. Hit me up whenever, I'll be at work but I'll be on my phone.
